concerns.why: src/sentry/api/paginator.py: `stop = offset + limit + extra; results = list(queryset[offset:stop])` was replaced in the shared BasePaginator.get_result, which is the parent of DateTimePaginator/OffsetPaginator and many others.

concerns.advisory: No tests are added anywhere in the diff for `OptimizedCursorPaginator`, the `optimized_pagination` query-param branch, or the modified base-paginator offset clamping, so none of the new pagination paths or their permission gate are covered.
concerns.why: The diff touches three source files (organization_auditlogs.py, paginator.py, cursors.py) and adds ~100 lines of new paginator logic with zero accompanying test files.

concerns.advisory: The new behavior is gated on a raw, undocumented query parameter (`optimized_pagination=true`) rather than a feature flag or options entry, so it cannot be disabled or rolled back without a code deploy.

concerns.why: Both the endpoint branch and the `if self.enable_advanced_features and cursor.offset < 0:` block in OptimizedCursorPaginator perform the privileged query with no logging, metrics, or analytics call.

concerns.why: The ~60-line body of the new get_result duplicates the count_hits/extra/build_cursor/post_query_filter sequence already present in BasePaginator.get_result in the same file.
